cited.quote: 3,299 free House Site pattas/ e-pattas have been issued to eligible families
Policy Note of Revenue and Disaster Management Department - 2026-2027

rationale: C1 reports that after this Government's formation, free house site pattas were issued by regularising long-standing residential encroachments on unobjectionable Government poramboke lands, matching the promise. Only the year (2026, from C1's title) is supportable since the extract itself is undated; the scale of coverage is unclear.
